detail.command:
printf '%s
' '=== STATUS ==='; git status --short; printf '%s
' '=== PACKAGE ==='; cat package.json; printf '%s
' '=== SRC TREE ==='; find src -maxdepth 3 -type f -print | sort; printf '%s
' '=== CORE/CONTRACT FILES ==='; for f in src/core/*.ts src/config/*.ts src/types/*.ts; do if [ -f "$f" ]; then echo "--- $f"; sed -n '1,240p' "$f"; fi; done
